events.description: At least 157 people dead and hundreds of tourists among missing after roads, bridges and power plants swept away Nepal-Tibet flash floods – live updates At least 157 people have been killed and hundreds, including large numbers of foreign tourists, are missing after flash floods ⁠hit the Himalayan border areas of ⁠Nepal and Tibet in China, police have said, with parts of India also at risk. The disaster was caused by a torrent of mud, water and debris that burst from the banks of a river that runs between China and Nepal. Homes, roads, bridges and power plants were swept away in Nepal, ⁠while officials in Tibet said they feared “major casualties”. Continue reading...

events.title: Red Cross mobilises in Nepal following natural disaster: 'Entire villages & communities washed out'
events.description: François Picard is pleased to welcome Tommaso Della Longa, Spokesperson for the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. The immediate challenge in Nepal is not only the scale of destruction, explains Della Longa, but the difficulty of reaching communities whose roads, bridges and communications have been swept away. Their priority remains search and rescue and the delivery of life-saving assistance, even as they begin preparing for longer-term recovery. Yet this is also a deeply human crisis for first responders: local Red Cross volunteers are supporting their own communities while some have themselves lost homes or relatives.

events.title: New study shows German football remains male-dominated
events.description: The top leagues of German football remain a largely male environment. A new study reveals that only seven clubs have women in upper management levels.

events.title: Could new US sanctions tear China and Iran apart?
events.description: Washington's strategy of putting maximum economic pressure on Iran is tempered by its desire to smooth political tensions with China.

events.title: DW users on life in Russia: 'People are mad as hell'
events.description: Official polling suggests public sentiment in Russia is deteriorating as economic pressure builds. DW asked its users to share their experiences.

events.title: Why social media harms are hard to regulate
events.description: Meta and other social media platforms face lawsuits alleging they foster addictive use among young people. Now regulators are struggling to rein in their engagement-driven business models.

events.title: CDU's Volkmann: Ukraine aid is not charity
events.description: Former German Chancellor Helmut Kohl's grandson Johannes Volkmann spoke to DW about why Germany must continue to support Ukraine.

events.title: Germany news: Merz courts 'frugals' to trim EU budget
events.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz is hosting leaders from several European Union net contributor countries as Berlin pushes for a smaller bloc budget. DW has more.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Germany news: Merz courts 'frugals' to trim EU budget

events.title: Norway holds its breath as King Harald's health deteriorates
events.description: Norway's King Harald was in a "very serious" condition in hospital ​on Thursday, the royal court said, and family members gathered at his bedside. Hundreds of people gathered outside the Royal Palace in central Oslo and many ​lay flowers ‌as they awaited further news of the 89-year-old ⁠king's health.

events.title: Optimus Prime voice actor dies
events.description: Peter Cullen, who voiced characters in Winnie the Pooh and Transformers, has died aged 85, his agent and family have confirmed.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Optimus Prime voice actor dies

events.title: 'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladic dies
events.description: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb general convicted of genocide, has died.
events.ticker_label: 💥 'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladic dies

events.title: King and Queen to visit Antigua and Barbuda
events.description: The King and Queen will undertake a royal visit to Antigua and Barbuda during an autumn tour, Buckingham Palace has announced.

events.title: One in two Britons back anticipated Israeli settlement trade ban
events.description: One in two Britons backs a ban on trade with Israeli West Bank settlements, polling suggests.

events.title: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama dies aged 97
events.description: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama, known for her polka dot art, has died aged 97.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama dies aged 97

events.title: Former head of Rwanda's presidential guard dies in prison, his brother says
events.description: Tom Byabagamba, a former commander of President Paul Kagame’s elite presidential guard, has died in prison after 12 years behind bars
events.ticker_label: 💥 Former head of Rwanda's presidential guard dies in prison, his brother says

events.title: Carney to address European Parliament as Canada deepens ties after break with Trump
events.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will address the European Parliament next month in a high-profile visit that underscores Canada’s push to deepen ties with Europe

events.title: From troubled hearts to lost keys, Greeks bake cakes for a wish-granting saint
events.description: Saint Fanourios, the Orthodox Christian patron saint of lost things, is honored each Aug. 27 with prayers and traditional orange-flavored cake

events.title: Car rams pedestrians in northern France, killing 1 and injuring 10
events.description: Authorities say a driver has deliberately rammed a car into a group of people in northern France, killing two people and injuring nine others

events.title: Canada is bolstering its defense industry as US relations fray
events.description: Canadian military spending is surging, with companies expanding into defense contracting

events.title: Norwegian King Harald's health is in very serious condition, palace says
events.description: Norwegian King Harald is in very serious condition as his health deteriorates, according to palace officials

events.title: More health workers, stronger systems: Africa’s new ambitious goal
events.description: Facing a projected shortage of more than six million health professionals by 2035, African countries are stepping up efforts to strengthen their workforce, with a new decade-long plan announced on Wednesday during a meeting of health ministers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

events.title: Can restoring land create jobs? These young entrepreneurs are proving it
events.description: From Ecuador to Bangladesh, a new generation of entrepreneurs is turning land restoration into economic opportunity. Whether repurposing agricultural waste, building greenhouses or deploying AI-powered sensors, they are showing, with support from a United Nations-backed initiative, that restoring land can also generate income and improve livelihoods.

events.title: Gaza: Children still at risk despite drop in acute hunger
events.description: Among tent cities pitched on the rubble of destroyed homes in Gaza, children are, by one measure, finally getting enough to eat. By another, however, many of them may never fully recover, according to a new study by the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) released on Monday.

events.title: California pastor charged with yearslong child molestation as investigators seek more victims: DA
events.description: David Johnson, an Ojai pastor and massage therapist, faces six felony child molestation charges in Ventura County as investigators seek more victims.

events.title: Former Gitmo prosecutor likens 9/11 trial delay to 'Frankenstein's zombie court'
events.description: Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and three alleged 9/11 co-conspirators will face trial in June 2028 as the Guantánamo military commission sets new deadlines.

events.title: Bryan Kohberger’s 2027 hearing is not guaranteed as Idaho seeks quick dismissal
events.description: Bryan Kohberger faces key deadlines as Idaho judge outlines how his attempt to withdraw his guilty plea will proceed, with a hearing tentatively set.

events.title: Judge sentences Lily Peters' killer 4 years after 10-year-old found dead in woods
events.description: Carson Peters-Berger, now 18, pleaded guilty to first-degree intentional homicide in the 2022 killing of cousin Lily Peters in Chippewa Falls.

events.title: Karoline Leavitt heads for White House exit as speculation builds over replacement and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Coast Guard seizes 7K pounds of cocaine worth more than $54 million near Puerto Rico, five arrested
events.description: The U.S. Coast Guard seized 7,250 pounds of cocaine worth $54.5 million from a suspected smuggling boat intercepted off the coast of Puerto Rico.

events.title: Man accused of using fake Chief Justice Roberts signature to get own criminal case dismissed
events.description: Joshua Culver allegedly forged Chief Justice John Roberts' signature on a fake Supreme Court dismissal order to get his Indiana criminal case thrown out.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy didn't show 'break with reality' as jury weighs psychosis defense: Susan Smith prosecutor
events.description: The prosecutor who secured a conviction for Susan Smith says Lindsay Clancy's defense never proved a break with reality as jurors prepare to deliberate Thursday.

events.title: Florida driver fleeing traffic stop slams head-on into school bus carrying 19 children before fleeing on foot
events.description: Video captures Qahiem Williams allegedly fleeing a traffic stop and slamming head-on into a Florida school bus carrying 19 children before fleeing on foot.

events.title: Accused 9/11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, 3 co-defendants set for 2028 trial
events.description: A military judge set a 2028 trial date for accused 9/11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and three alleged co-conspirators held at Guantánamo Bay.

events.title: Hundreds of volunteers pull 360-tonne historic Japanese castle back into place by hand
events.description: About 1,800 volunteers pulled ropes to move the 360-tonne Hirosaki Castle keep back into position using hikiya, an ancient Japanese moving technique.

events.title: Iran tried to assassinate one of Netanyahu's sons, prime minister says
events.description: Benjamin Netanyahu claims Iran tried to murder one of his sons, urging enhanced protection for prime ministerial candidates during the election campaign.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Iran tried to assassinate one of Netanyahu's sons, prime minister says

events.title: Mexican governor facing US drug charges seeks leave just one day after returning to office
events.description: Embattled Sinaloa Gov. Rubén Rocha Moya's abrupt reversal follows pointed remarks from Mexico's President Claudia Sheinbaum about putting nation above personal interest.

events.title: Woman in her 30s who pretended to be a child and lived with family found guilty of fraud
events.description: Amanda Maria Souza de Oliveira, 37, lived with a family as their daughter for 14 months before her elaborate child identity fraud was uncovered.
